title: Sanctuary Retreat New Address
content: Emily has been relocated to Sanctuary Retreat, a safe house. The new address is 458 Cedarwood Lane, Whispering Pines, Evergreen County, EC-4587.

title: Hope for Homes Gala Summary
content: The Hope for Homes Gala was a tremendous success. We managed to raise over $50,000, which will go towards providing essential resources for our clients. This event has significantly impacted our ability to support those in need at Safe Haven Support Services.
